definitions.explanation: The extent to which something blocks light — the quantitative measure of how non-transparent a material, color, or digital layer is. In physics and materials science, it describes how much light is absorbed; in graphics software, it is the setting that controls how visible a layer or shape is, from fully invisible to fully solid.

examples.japanese: {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
レイヤー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I set the layer's opacity to fifty percent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧テクスチャー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧、⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすく⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I lowered the opacity of the background texture so that the text was easier to read.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧ (opaque, not transparent) and the suffix ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (-ness, degree). A scientific/technical term that names a measurable quantity — the degree of opacity — rather than simply saying something is opaque.

USAGE:
- Encountered most often in two contexts: (1) materials science / optics, where it quantifies how much light a substance blocks; (2) graphics and design software, where it is the standard translation of the English UI term "Opacity" (often rendered as an adjustable slider or percentage).
- Takes adjustival modifiers: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{不透明度|ふとうめいど} (high opacity), ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧{不透明度|ふとうめいど} (low opacity).
- In software, users often say {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (lower the opacity) rather than "make more transparent."
- The opposite concept is ⟦{透明度|とうめいど}→透明度：25289_toumeido⟧ (transparency, degree of clarity), which is more common in everyday speech (e.g., describing water clarity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise the opacity
- {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to lower the opacity
- {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set the opacity
- {不透明度|ふとうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: the opacity is high
- レイヤー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不透明度|ふとうめいど}: layer opacity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{透明度|とうめいど}→透明度：25289_toumeido⟧: transparency — the inverse measure; common in everyday usage (e.g., of water)
- ⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧: opaque — the adjective form, also used figuratively for "unclear" (as in political situations)
- {透過率|とうかりつ}: transmittance — a more technical optics term, the percentage of light that passes through
- ⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧: density, concentration — sometimes used loosely in graphics software in place of opacity
